shortBio.en: Guns N’ Roses drummer on Appetite; swing feel, exits ~1990.
shortBio.zh: Appetite 时期 Guns N’ Roses 鼓手；摇摆手感，约 1990 离开。

body.en:
Classic-five drummer. Behind-the-beat swing under Slash/Izzy riffs. Fired/exits around 1990; Matt Sorum covers later Illusion tours.

Person page marks the Appetite pocket vs later kit chairs.
body.zh:
经典五人鼓手。在 Slash/Izzy riff 下拖拍摇摆。约 1990 被撤/离开；后来 Illusion 巡演由 Matt Sorum 顶。

人物页用来标出 Appetite 口袋拍与后来鼓位之别。
